title: Suara publisher
description: One official body in the central registry. Entries reference a publisher by code. Only publishers listed here may be collected from.

code.description: Short, uppercase, stable. The same code the entry id uses in lowercase.

type.description: configured: an official source added by configuration that is not a ministry or statutory board.

parent_ministry.description: For a statutory board, the code of its parent ministry.

domains.description: Hostnames whose pages count as this publisher's own. A quote from any other host is rejected.

sources.description: Where collection starts for this publisher.
